purpose: Record support release on the operator-stopped faucet trial.
release: The interface and supports came off together. The photos show the separated annulus and the open insert-pocket mouths.
scope: A stopped print shows support release and surface appearance on the printed lower curve.
operator_quotes: That print that I stopped just now did come apart very cleanly.
I wanted them to be on the outside. I didn't want trees on the outside of the fins.
But this came off in one unit anyways.

So I think we just go back to the trees only and get rid of the fins, because the point is the interface layers should break off, and I think it's the removal of the heat sets that really made that possible here just now.
